MP = np.load('/work/gen_1_acts/mlp_last_prompt.npy').astype(np.float32)

S = [r['samples'][0] for r in g1]
lengths=np.array([s['tokens'] for s in S])
correct=np.array([s['correct'] for s in S],bool)
cuts=np.array([s['cut'] for s in S],bool)
src=np.array([r['source'] for r in g1])
ids=[r['id'] for r in g1]
encoded=[tok.encode(s['text'],add_special_tokens=False) for s in S]
def repeat_fraction(tokens,n=12):
    grams=[tuple(tokens[i:i+n]) for i in range(max(0,len(tokens)-n+1))]
    return 1-len(set(grams))/max(1,len(grams))
rep8=np.array([repeat_fraction(x[:8192]) for x in encoded])
repall=np.array([repeat_fraction(x) for x in encoded])
print("Counts:",collections.Counter((r['source'],s['correct'],s['cut']) for r,s in zip(g1,S)))
for i in np.argsort(repall)[-18:][::-1]:
    print(ids[i],bool(correct[i]),int(lengths[i]),round(float(rep8[i]),3),round(float(repall[i]),3))
bad=np.where((src=='aime') & cuts)[0]
ctrl=np.where((src=='aime') & correct & (lengths>8192))[0]
print("Contrasts:",len(bad),"cut AIME vs",len(ctrl),"long correct AIME")
scale=np.sqrt(M[bad].var(0)/len(bad)+M[ctrl].var(0)/len(ctrl)+1e-7)
tstat=(M[bad].mean(0)-M[ctrl].mean(0))/scale
candidates=[]
for l in range(32):
    for j in np.argsort(np.abs(tstat[l]))[-3:][::-1]:
        candidates.append((float(abs(tstat[l,j])),l,int(j),float(tstat[l,j]),
                           float(M[bad,l,j].mean()),float(M[ctrl,l,j].mean())))
print("Top component contrasts (hypothesis generation, not causal evidence):")
for row in sorted(candidates,reverse=True)[:28]:
    print(tuple(round(v,4) if isinstance(v,float) else v for v in row))
